input.summary: Delete the one-way non-solicitation covenant binding IBM in Section 9.0(f).
input.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted Section 9.0(f): it is a one-way, multi-year non-solicit binding only IBM and covering all Transferred Employees regardless of their involvement in the work, which fails our position that no non-solicitation restriction applies to us. If you need a covenant here, we can accept a mutual one limited to personnel directly involved in the Services for 12 months after their involvement ends, with the existing general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no restriction on hiring.
